name: read
description: Reads whole text files from literal paths and glob patterns. Use shallow_read to inspect selected content sizes before requesting bodies.

include.description: Literal file paths or glob patterns. This override accepts whole-file string requests only.

exclude.description: Additional glob patterns that filter automatically discovered files, not literal paths.

use_ignore_files.description: Whether configured ignoreFiles rules filter glob results. Defaults to true; literal paths bypass ignore rules.

shallow_read.description: False includes successful bodies; true omits them. A positive integer includes all successful bodies only when their combined UTF-8 size is within that byte limit. Statistics and failures are always returned.

show_line_numbers.description: Prefix returned content lines with their original 1-based line numbers. Defaults to false.
